designationHistory.indexText: Established in 1970 as an overlay on U.S. Army Corps of Engineers land at Robert S. Kerr Reservoir, created by the McClellan-Kerr Arkansas River Navigation System.

authority.citation: Cooperative agreement with the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers (overlay refuge)

designationHistory.note: The refuge page gives only the month or year. The refuge page does not say how it was established.

sources.name: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service: Sequoyah National Wildlife Refuge, About Us
